summary: Prudential plc furnished a 6-K reporting daily purchases under its buy-back programme. On 7-11 September 2026, the company bought 3,504,263 ordinary shares on XLON at a volume-weighted average of roughly 10.0049p-10.2471p per share, within a 9.7760-10.3000p daily range, from JP Morgan Securities plc under arrangements announced 6 January and 2 September 2026. Shares will be cancelled, leaving 2,489,324,295 in issue. Since programme inception, 64,622,674 shares were repurchased at a 1,076.4913p volume-weighted average. Watch execution pace versus prior tranches and any acceleration in cancellation-driven float reduction.
